_about: Which SEA-LION model checks each language: the newest model whose documentation lists that language and that the API offers. Languages no model lists (coverage: base) are checked with Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5, relying on its Qwen3.6 base model's coverage. Re-verify against docs.sea-lion.ai before re-running; update 'checked' when you do.

evidence.v4.8: Nemotron-SEA-LION-v4.8 (released Sep 2026, the latest): Balinese, Burmese, English, Indonesian, Javanese, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Mandarin, Sundanese, Tamil, Thai, Vietnamese. https://docs.sea-lion.ai/models/sea-lion-v4.8/nemotron-sea-lion-v4.8
evidence.v4.5: Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5 and Gemma-SEA-LION-v4.5 (released May 2026): Burmese, Indonesian, Filipino, Malay, Tamil, Thai, Vietnamese. https://docs.sea-lion.ai/models/sea-lion-v4.5/qwen-sea-lion-v4.5
evidence.v4: SEA-LION v4 models (released Aug 2025): Burmese, English, Indonesian, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Mandarin, Tagalog, Tamil, Thai, Vietnamese. https://docs.sea-lion.ai/models/sea-lion-v4
evidence.none: No SEA-LION model page (v3 to v4.8, Guard v2) lists Hindi, Bengali (Bangla) or Urdu among the languages SEA-LION was trained for (re-checked 30 Oct 2026; the API offers no newer model than v4.8). Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5's page says it is 'built upon the Qwen3.6-27B dense architecture' and supports '201 languages globally': that coverage comes from the base model, so these three are checked with it, as a weaker second opinion.

aisingapore/Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5-27B-IT.why: thinking off: with it on, each request was ~20x slower and could use up the token budget

tl.note: v4.8 does not list Filipino/Tagalog; v4.5 is the newest release that does. Gemma-SEA-LION-v4.5 is not offered by the API.

hi.note: Not one of SEA-LION's tuned languages. Checked with Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5, whose base model (Qwen3.6) covers Hindi among its 201 languages; SEA-LION's own training did not add Hindi, so treat this check as weaker than for Tamil or Burmese.

bn.note: Not one of SEA-LION's tuned languages. Checked with Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5, whose base model (Qwen3.6) covers Bengali among its 201 languages; SEA-LION's own training did not add Bengali, so treat this check as weaker than for Tamil or Burmese.

ur.note: Not one of SEA-LION's tuned languages. Checked with Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5, whose base model (Qwen3.6) covers Urdu among its 201 languages; SEA-LION's own training did not add Urdu, so treat this check as weaker than for Tamil or Burmese.
